title: INT8 and four-bit quantization

paper.title: LLM.int8(): 8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale

related.title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers

paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement INT8 and four-bit quantization: implement calibrated integer quantization and a documented four-bit extension; audit scale zero-point error and memory. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use quantization-fixture; required output: Quantized linear input -> dequantized output. Evaluate relative_output_error (minimize). Saturation rounding zero points and per-group scale storage included in memory. Required ablation: Compare per-tensor per-channel and grouped scales on fixed calibration examples. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
